description: The review defines SM as \"a set of strategies that students are trained in to assess, monitor, and/or evaluate their own behavioral performance\", drawing on behavioral psychology and cognitive-behavioral theories.
title: Self-management (SM) intervention framework: eleven self-directed elements spanning assessment, monitoring, and evaluation of behavioral performance

description: The review proposes two behavioral principles underlying SM.
title: Mechanisms of change in self-management interventions: reactivity to self-monitoring and perceived autonomy

description: The article adopts Smith et al.'s (2011) framework, which classifies privacy definitions into value-based (privacy as a right or commodity) and cognate-based (privacy as a state or control) approaches.
title: Smith et al.'s value-based and cognate-based categorization of privacy definitions as an analytical lens for LA
